name: pace
description: Shows when a session gets heavy or its prompt cache is about to go cold, and parks a session so the next one can resume it

park_dir.title: Resume point folder
park_dir.description: Where park writes resume points (one small markdown file each). Leave empty for ~/.local/state/pace/parked

summary.title: Summary when parking
summary.description: Add a model-written summary to a resume point: never, only while the prompt cache is warm (cheap), or always

resume_scope.title: Show resume points from
resume_scope.description: Only resume points parked in this folder, or all of them

warn.title: Heavy: toast at
warn.description: Context size (tokens) that toasts once: every turn now re-reads this much

high.title: Heavy: band at
high.description: Context size (tokens) that keeps a row above the prompt

cold_warn.title: Cold cache: show from
cold_warn.description: Context size (tokens) from which a cold cache gets a row; below it a re-write is cheap

big_result.title: Jump: tokens
big_result.description: Tokens one step must add to the context to count as a jump

cache_ttl_minutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cache_ttl_minutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request: 60 on the 1-hour cache, 5 on the 5-minute one

expiring_minutes.title: Countdown from (minutes)
expiring_minutes.description: Minutes before the cache goes cold when the countdown starts

hint.title: Suggestion
hint.description: Text after the heavy and cold messages, e.g. your own way of starting fresh

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: Keep one line under the prompt with the context size, turn count and cache countdown of this session

topic_check.title: New topic check
topic_check.description: Once the context is past the toast level, ask a small model (Haiku, a few hundred tokens) whether a new prompt starts a different task, and suggest parking. Set off to never call a model
